valor: Represented as herons, a daughter travels to a small, faraway town in Colombia to visit her father. On this journey to the mountains, both will have to come face to face with nature. At times they will feel strong; at others, filled with fear. Out of fear and the lack of a voice, one of them will turn into a monster condemned to the deepest solitude.
motivo: la de TMDB no cuenta esta obra; traducida de la española

antes.ficcali-2026: In Bogota's noisy and violent big city machine people carry their nature only limply in their hands, surrendering without resistance to disconcerting rituals.
